subject: GGIR 2.7.1 do not have part4 when use sleeplog file

messages.author: a0c9c53065dc7f03
messages.subject: GGIR 2.7.1 do not have part4 when use sleeplog file
parts:
Hello

Do you get the part4 summary results when you use sleeplog file and run GGIR2.7.1?

I used to run this successfully in GGIR 2.4.0. When I rerun this data processing by GGIR 2.7.1 with a sleeplog file applied,  I got the following messages

Report part 4
 loading all the milestone data from part 4 this can take a few minutes
[1] "report not stored, because no results available"

The part4 results are not generated although /QC/part4*full.csv was generated.

Do you encounter the same issue?

Thanks.
Best,
Dora

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] GGIR 2.7.1 do not have part4 when use sleeplog file
parts:
Hello Dora,

Have you tried using the latest GGIR version from GitHub? I created a new GitHub-only 2.7-4 release yesterday. With this latest release I am able to create part 4 reports and as far as I can see 2.7-1 should also work. Our plan is to create a new CRAN release in September.

If the above does not address the issue then maybe try to narrow down in which release the error emerged, because a lot has happened since 2.4-0. We can then compare that with the changes to GGIR for each release: https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/blob/master/inst/NEWS.Rd. 

You can install specific versions of GGIR with remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", ref = "2.4-0"). Possibly you need to uninstall GGIR and restart R between updates.

Another issue could be that changes to parts 2 or part 3 are affecting consistency with part 4. In that case you may want to reprocess part 2 and 3 as well. I do not expect part 1 to be the problem, because I am using older part 1 milestone data for various projects.

Finally, deleting the config.csv file may also help as GGIR uses this as fall-back option when defining argument value default.

Best, Vincent
